records.validity: Aggregate-only evidence from an independently replayed 384-coordinate, train-only grouped-OOD structure pilot. The 37-drug all-ITT analysis includes 22 strict ChEBI largest-fragment canonical-isomeric parents and 15 explicit missing fallbacks. Tanimoto transfer, CPA-style additive Ridge, and low-rank structure-context bilinear Ridge are all rejected for promotion. The Adapter verifies frozen aggregate scalars and does not retrain the private study or claim an exact CPA/chemCPA reproduction.

records.validity: Release-safe blind/freeze/unblind pilot for one opaque treated entity and four mechanism arms. The correct arm yielded high-ranking responders and one supported module-level state but zero exact top-five overlap; a counterfactual-direction arm supported the same broad state, preventing unique causal identification. The Adapter ships no identity, transcript, mapping, protein vector or prediction.

Release-safe post-hoc downstream-state abundance audit. Neither prespecified primary marker passed its coverage, effect, interval, multiplicity and trajectory-agreement gate. Four abundance modules remain explicitly exploratory and are not pathway-activity or causal estimates. The Adapter ships no query identity, marker name, module membership, trajectory label or protein vector.
